reference_method: Class means (nir,red) are (2,2/3) for label 1 and (7,2/3) for label 3. Equal second coordinates make the decision boundary nir=4.5. All sample points have a unique nearest mean. Outlier (6,0) from training class 1 must predict class 3, proving this is nearest class mean rather than nearest training observation. Training accuracy=5/6 and kappa=2/3. Held-out predictions [1,3,3,1,3] with order [3,1] yield [[2,1],[1,1]], accuracy 3/5 and kappa 1/6.
